title.zh: 粒子与物态 · 热闹程度即温度
title.en: Particles & States · Temperature Is How Wildly They Move

description.zh: 固、液、气不是三种东西，是同一群粒子的三种队形：固体排好队原地抖，液体贴身滑动，气体满屋乱飞。加热就是让粒子闹得更凶，闹到挣脱队形就熔化、沸腾。
description.en: Solid, liquid and gas are not three things but three formations of the same particles: solids vibrate in formation, liquids slide past each other, gases fly free. Heating makes particles wilder; wild enough to break formation, they melt and boil.

label.zh: 温度就是粒子闹腾程度的标尺
label.en: Temperature gauges how wildly particles move

reason.zh: 本页温度滑杆直接调粒子抖动的剧烈程度，温度读数与粒子平均动能同源——这正是分子动理论的定性口径：越热，粒子平均动得越凶。
reason.en: This page's temperature slider directly sets how violently particles vibrate, and its reading shares its source with average particle kinetic energy — the qualitative statement of kinetic theory: hotter means wilder on average.

label.zh: 粒子是分子原子的教学化身
label.en: Particles are the teaching stand-in for molecules and atoms

reason.zh: 固液气不是三种东西，是同一群粒子排出的三种队形；粒子页画的圆盘，就是分子原子尺度的放大图。
reason.en: Solid, liquid and gas are not three things but three formations of the same particles; the discs this page draws are the magnified picture of the molecular and atomic scale.

label.zh: 蒸发与沸腾是水循环里的两条进气路
label.en: Evaporation and boiling are water's two routes into gas

reason.zh: 一杯水变干是表面少数粒子逃逸，烧开是全体挣脱成气；水循环追踪的正是同一批水在这两条路与液化之间跑。
reason.en: A cup drying out is a few surface particles escaping; boiling is everyone breaking free. The water cycle tracks the same water running between these two routes and liquefaction.
